Label: RiskView Score
Description: LexisNexis RiskView credit risk score derived from public records, property data, and alternative data. Used for thin-file and subprime populations.
Special Values: -1=No Score / Insufficient Data; -3=Identity Not Verified; -5=No Hit; -7=Not Available; 222=Fraud Indicator

Label: RiskView Liens & Judgments Score
Description: LexisNexis score based on lien filing history, tax liens, and judgment records.

Label: Address Stability Score
Description: Score indicating residential address stability based on length at current and previous addresses, number of address changes.

Label: Months at Current Address
Description: Number of months the applicant has resided at their current address per LexisNexis records.

Label: Number of Address Changes in 5 Years
Description: Count of distinct residential address changes in the past 5 years.

Label: Property Ownership Indicator
Description: Indicator whether the individual is identified as a property owner through deed and tax records. 0=No, 1=Yes.
Special Values: 0=Not a Property Owner; 1=Property Owner; -1=Unknown; -5=No Hit; -7=Not Available

Label: Estimated Household Income
Description: LexisNexis modeled estimate of household income based on property values, neighborhood data, and public records.

Label: Number of Property Deeds
Description: Count of property deeds on record for the individual.

Label: Total Property Value
Description: Aggregate assessed or estimated market value of all properties owned by the individual.

Label: Number of Tax Liens
Description: Count of federal and state tax liens filed against the individual.

Label: Number of Eviction Filings
Description: Count of eviction filings associated with the individual.

Label: Number of Felony Records
Description: Count of felony criminal records found for the individual.

Label: FraudPoint Score
Description: LexisNexis FraudPoint score indicating the likelihood of identity fraud. Higher scores indicate higher fraud risk.

Label: Identity Verification Level
Description: Level of identity verification achieved. 1=Full Match, 2=Partial Match, 3=Name Only, 4=Address Only, 5=No Match.
Special Values: 1=Full Match (SSN+Name+DOB+Address); 2=Partial Match (3 of 4 elements); 3=Name Only Match; 4=Address Only Match; 5=No Match; -1=Unable to Verify; -5=No Hit; -7=Not Available

Label: Phone Verification Status
Description: Whether the applicant's phone number is verified and matches known records. 0=Not Verified, 1=Verified.

Label: Number of Associated Addresses
Description: Total count of distinct addresses historically associated with the individual.

Label: Professional License Indicator
Description: Whether the individual holds any professional license (medical, legal, financial, engineering, etc.). 0=No, 1=Yes.
Special Values: 0=No Professional License; 1=Has Professional License; -1=No Data; -5=No Hit; -7=Not Available
